prospectus.objective: The Fund seeks to provide investors with returns that are twice those of the Underlying ETF, up to the upside cap of 10.20% (prior to taking into account management fees and other fees) while approximately matching Underlying ETF losses, over the period from April 1, 2026 through June 30, 2026.
prospectus.strategy: General Strategy Description. Due to the unique mechanics of the Funds strategy, the return an investor can expect to receive from an investment in the Fund has characteristics that are distinct from many other investment vehicles. It is important that an investor understand these characteristics before making an investment in the Fund. The Fund has adopted a policy pursuant to Rule 35d -1 under the 1940 Act to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in investments that provide exposure to the Invesco QQQ Trust SM , Series 1. The Funds strategy has been specifically designed to produce the Outcomes described below based upon the performance of the Underlying ETF over the duration of the Outcome Period. The Fund seeks replicate the performance of the Underlying ETF over the duration of the Outcome Period, subject to the below pre -determined Outcomes. There is no guarantee that the Fund will be successful in its attempt to provide the Outcomes for an Outcome Period. Potential Upside Accelerated Return and Participation in Underlying ETF Losses, if any. The Fund seeks to provide shareholders with returns that are two times the increase in value experienced by the Underlying ETF ( i.e. , Accelerated Return) over the course of the Outcome Period, subject to the Cap (described below). To the extent the Underlying ETF decreases in value over the duration of the Outcome Period, the Fund seeks to provide shareholders that hold Shares for the entire Outcome Period with a decrease in value that is approximately equal to the share price decrease experienced by the Underlying ETF. Unlike other ETFs that utilize defined outcome investing strategies, the Fund does not provide a buffer ( i.e. , protection against a specified percentage amount of Underlying ETF losses over a period of time) against Underlying ETF losses. Upside Accelerated Returns Subject to a Cap. The Fund seeks to provide shareholders that hold Shares for the entire Outcome Period with the Accelerated Return, if the Underlying ETF appreciates in value, subject to the Cap. The Cap represents the maximum percentage return an investor can achieve from an investment in the Fund over the duration of the Outcome Period. The Cap is set on the first day of the Outcome Period and is 10.20% prior to taking into account any fees or expenses charged to shareholders. When the Funds annual Fund management fee of 0.79% of the Funds average daily net assets is taken into account for the Outcome Period, the Cap is 10.00%. To produce the Outcomes, the Fund invests in FLEX Options that reference the Underlying ETF and may also invest in the Underlying ETF (or the components thereof) directly. If, in any year, the Fund fails to qualify as a RIC under the applicable tax laws, the Fund would be taxed as an ordinary corporation. The use of derivative instruments involves risks different from, or possibly greater than, the risks associated with investing directly in securities and other traditional investments. Valuation Risk

Valuation Risk. During periods of reduced market liquidity or in the absence of readily available market quotations for the holdings of the Fund, the valuation of the Funds FLEX Options will become more difficult. In market environments where there is reduced availability of reliable objective pricing data, the judgment of the Funds investment adviser in determining the fair value of the security may play a greater role. While such determinations may be made in good faith, it may nevertheless be more difficult for the Fund to accurately assign a daily value.
Risk Not Insured Depository Institution
An investment in the Fund is not a deposit of a bank and is not insured or guaranteed by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation or any other governmental agency.
